第二节课是医学基础课。

上课铃响了，教室里安静下来。一个五十来岁的男人走进教室，穿着一件灰色的中山装，袖口磨得发白，领子也起了毛。头发花白，戴着一副黑框眼镜，镜片后面的眼睛有些浑浊。他走上讲台，把一本薄薄的讲义放在桌上，然后转过身面对学生，神情有些拘谨，说话也小心翼翼。

“同学们好，我姓张，以后负责教你们人体解剖学。”

他在黑板上写下“人体解剖学”几个字，字迹工整有力，一笔一划都透着功底。

张老师翻开讲义，开始讲课。当他讲开课时，整个人变得专注了，声音也稳了，不像刚才那么小心翼翼。

“解剖学是医学的基础。不了解人体的结构，就谈不上诊断和治疗。”他转过身，在黑板上画了一幅人体骨骼的简图，一边画一边说，“伟人说，中国医药学是一个伟大的宝库，应当努力发掘，加以提高。我们既要学习中医，也要学习西医，走中西医结合的道路。”

他开始讲解人体的基本结构，从骨骼系统讲起。颅骨、躯干骨、四肢骨，一块一块地讲，形态、位置、功能，讲得很慢，就怕学员们听不懂。讲到关键的地方，他会在黑板上画图，画得又快又好，骨骼的轮廓、关节的形状，一笔一笔的，清清楚楚。

王建新坐在第三排，腰板挺直，拿出笔记本，一边听一边记。张老师讲的内容他大部分都懂——之前自学的西医基础理论里，解剖学占了很大篇幅。但他还是认真地听，认真地记，不漏掉一个细节。

王建新注意到，张老师讲课时很少看学员的眼睛，目光总是在黑板和讲稿之间游移。偶尔抬头扫一眼教室，目光也是虚的，不落在任何人身上。偶尔有学员小声说话，他的声音就会顿一下，等安静了再继续讲。

下课后，郭大江凑过来说：“这个张老师讲课挺认真的，就是有点紧张。”

陈志远也凑过来，压低声音说：“我打听了一下，这个老教授初期被打倒了，后来才解放出来上课。张老师以前是北医的老教授，现在还能站在讲台上，已经很不容易了。”

王建新点了点头，心里明白了为什么张老师讲课那么小心翼翼。

最后一节课是军事体育课，队列训练和基础体能。操场上，王建新带队，口号喊得震天响。学员们顶着秋日的太阳练了一个多小时——立正、稍息、向左转、向右转、齐步走、跑步走。体能训练是俯卧撑、仰卧起坐、深蹲起立，一套下来，不少学员累得气喘吁吁。

终于下课了。

午饭时间，六个人又聚在了一起。

食堂里的菜跟昨天差不多，猪肉白菜炖粉条，白面馒头管饱。刘卫东一边扒饭一边感叹：“一上午，政治、解剖、军体，这课排得够满的。”

林大山端起搪瓷茶缸喝了一口水，慢悠悠地说：“三年嘛，说长不长说短不短。咱们好歹是第一届工农兵学员，以后什么样还不知道呢。”

“我听说，”陈志远压低声音，“今年的课是精简过的，很多基础课都砍了，重点是临床实践。以后咱们大部分时间可能要下到工厂农村去，叫开门办学。”

赵振国推了推眼镜：“开门办学？那不是成了赤脚医生了吗？”

“差不多吧，”陈志远点头，“咱们本来就是工农兵学员，学完还得回原部队。北医的牌子虽然响，但学的可能跟地方卫校差不多。”

王建新没有参与讨论，但把这些话记在了心里。

The second class is a basic medical class.

The school bell rang and the classroom became quiet.A man in his fifties walked into the classroom, wearing a gray tunic suit. The cuffs were frayed white and the collar was ruffled.He has gray hair and wears a pair of black-rimmed glasses, and his eyes are a little cloudy behind the lenses.He walked up to the podium, put a thin handout on the table, and then turned around to face the students. He looked a little reserved and spoke carefully.

"Hello, classmates, my surname is Zhang, and I will be responsible for teaching you human anatomy from now on."

He wrote the words "Human Anatomy" on the blackboard. His handwriting was neat and powerful, and his skills were evident in every stroke.

Teacher Zhang opened the handout and started teaching.When he started the class, he became more focused and his voice was steady, not as cautious as before.

"Anatomy is the basis of medicine. If you don't understand the structure of the human body, you can't talk about diagnosis and treatment." He turned around and drew a simple diagram of the human skeleton on the blackboard, and said as he drew, "The great man said that Chinese medicine is a great treasure house that should be discovered and improved. We must learn both traditional Chinese medicine and Western medicine, and follow the path of integrating Chinese and Western medicine."

He began to explain the basic structure of the human body, starting with the skeletal system.The bones of the skull, trunk, and limbs were explained one by one, and the shape, position, and function were explained very slowly, for fear that the students would not understand.When it comes to key points, he will draw pictures on the blackboard quickly and well. The outlines of the bones and the shapes of the joints are clear one stroke at a time.

Wang Jianxin sat in the third row with his back straight, took out his notebook, and took notes while listening.He understands most of what Teacher Zhang talks about - anatomy occupies a large space in the basic theories of Western medicine that he taught himself before.But he still listened carefully and memorized it carefully, not missing a single detail.

Wang Jianxin noticed that Teacher Zhang rarely looked into the eyes of the students when he was giving lectures, and his eyes always wandered between the blackboard and the lecture notes.Occasionally he raised his head and glanced at the classroom, his eyes were empty and did not fall on anyone.Occasionally, if a student speaks in a low voice, his voice will pause for a moment, and then he will continue speaking after it becomes quiet.

After class, Guo Dajiang came over and said, "This teacher Zhang is very serious in teaching, but he is a little nervous."

Chen Zhiyuan also came over and lowered his voice and said: "I inquired about it and found out that this old professor was knocked down in the early stage, but was later freed to teach. Mr. Zhang used to be an old professor at Peking University, and it is not easy for him to still stand on the podium now."

Wang Jianxin nodded, understanding why Teacher Zhang was so cautious in teaching.

The last class is military physical education class, queue training and basic physical fitness.On the playground, Wang Jianxin led the team and shouted slogans loudly.The students practiced for more than an hour under the autumn sun - standing at attention, taking a break, turning left, turning right, walking in unison, and running.The physical training consists of push-ups, sit-ups, squats and stand-ups. After one set, many students are exhausted and out of breath.

get out of class is finally over.

At lunch time, the six people gathered together again.

The food in the cafeteria is similar to yesterday, including pork and cabbage stewed with vermicelli, and white-flour steamed buns.Liu Weidong sighed while eating his rice: "Politics, anatomy, and military physical education all morning, this class is full."

Lin Dashan picked up the enamel teapot and took a sip of water, and said slowly: "Three years is not a long time, but a short time. We are the first class of worker, peasant and soldier students, and we don't know what will happen in the future."

"I heard," Chen Zhiyuan lowered his voice, "this year's courses have been streamlined. Many basic courses have been cut, and the focus is on clinical practice. In the future, we may have to go to factories and rural areas most of the time to open the school."

Zhao Zhenguo pushed up his glasses: "Open the school? Doesn't that mean he has become a barefoot doctor?"

"More or less," Chen Zhiyuan nodded, "We are originally workers, peasants and soldiers students, and we have to return to the original army after studying. Although the brand of Beijing Medical University is famous, the training may be similar to that of local medical schools."

Wang Jianxin did not participate in the discussion, but took these words to heart.
